relationship: companion program to docs/CONTRACTED_EXECUTION_PLAN.md; contract/effects C1-C5 is the substrate
goal: Give long-lived projects stable project-scoped Leader/Manager/Worker identities with durable memory, inbox, workspaces, accountability, hiring, and retirement; keep Labour task-scoped.

labour.job: bulk implementation, tests, commit; no delegation

tasks.title: Identity schema, lifecycle, policy, and migration
deliverables: agent_identities and agent_runs additive tables
AgentIdentityPolicy project setting, default off
identity lifecycle events created/updated/paused/resumed/retired
replay/repair/db-rebuild/bundle coverage
compatibility agents projection; old sessions remain ephemeral
agent.identities read API and vp agents
tests: new identity rows project-scoped and event-backed
tasks.acceptance: Existing sessions keep current behavior; new identities are durable and project-scoped.

tasks.title: Session assignment, identity lease, and inbox
deliverables: session_agent_assignments with identity lease
agent_inbox project-scoped, pull-based
one active session per identity in v1
assignment can wake a session through continuation path
Labour only task-scoped inbox
tests: same Worker cannot be assigned to two active sessions
tasks.acceptance: Identity assignment and inbox are durable, project-scoped, and fenced.

tasks.title: Role contracts, prompts, and cache
deliverables: agent/identity stable prompt section
agent/memory tail section
Worker tech-lead contract: design/decompose/review/integrate; no bulk code
Labour implementation contract: code/tests/commit; no delegation
Manager department architect; Leader project/portfolio owner
Worker delegate_labour; Labour cannot delegate
identity generation participates in cache epoch
tests: Worker decomposes into Labour and reviews commits
identity section byte-identical across runs of same generation
tasks.acceptance: Stable identity prompts are cache-safe and Worker/Labour responsibilities are enforced by role policy.

tasks.title: Worker workspace and two-level integration
deliverables: project component branch per Worker identity
session worker worktree from component branch
Labour child task worktree from session worker worktree
Labour -> Worker deterministic merge with diff/path checks
Worker -> session Verifier/Integrator unchanged
identity/workspace lease prevents concurrent same-component writes
workspace archive/land and conflict rollback
tests: Labour commit merges into Worker workspace
Worker commit passes Verifier and session Integrator
two sessions cannot mutate same component workspace
conflict rolls back without changing session branch
tasks.acceptance: Two-level integration preserves Verifier/Integrator and component ownership.

tasks.title: Identity memory
deliverables: agent_memories with agent/department/project scope
evidence/provenance, TTL/stale/supersede
bounded memory brief
remember/recall scoped to identity/department/project
memory events and tail-only cache invalidation
tasks.acceptance: Identity memory is durable, evidence-backed, bounded, and cache-safe.

tasks.title: Hiring, retirement, and performance
deliverables: agent.hire/retire/promote/transfer with approval
project caps for Managers/Workers
AgentRetirementPolicy evidence-based proposals
performance ledger from task results/Verifier/attribution/cost/retries
successor workspace/memory transfer where safe
retired identity cannot be assigned; no auto-rehire
tests: retire retains evidence and releases assignments
tasks.acceptance: Hiring/retirement is explicit, evidence-based, capped, and non-destructive.

tasks.title: GUI, CLI, and observability
deliverables: project org chart Leader/Managers/Workers
identity detail: role, component, generation, assignments, inbox, memory, performance, retirement
hire/retire sheets
cross-session roster and workspace status
CLI agents/agent-hire/agent-retire/agent-inbox/agent-memory
OTel/event projections include identity id without secrets
tasks.acceptance: Operators can see and manage the project org chart through real RPCs.

tasks.title: Portable team templates / team charter
deliverables: TeamTemplate JSON schema with leader/departments/workers/labour defaults/rules/budgets/model bindings/tool policy/skills/conventions
deterministic TEAM.md rendering and content hash
export from project roster/policies with context/memory/secrets/IDs/paths redacted
import preview, validation, dry-run, and approval-classified apply
team_templates and project_team_templates storage plus manifest/db-rebuild
optional identity instantiation through S6 hire; never overwrite existing identities
target project policy wins; no budget/approval/sandbox/MCP/Verifier widening
RPC/CLI/GUI team template library, diff, org-chart preview, conflict sheet
tests: no context/memory/secrets/agent IDs/session IDs/absolute paths in export
identity provenance hash recorded on hire
tasks.acceptance: A successful project can export a portable team charter, import it into another project, and get the same roles/rules with fresh memory and no context leakage.

migration.new_sessions: create/assign identities only when AgentIdentityPolicy is enabled
migration.rollback: disable policy; stop new assignments; identities remain readable/retired

acceptance: identity lease prevents concurrent same-workspace writes
cache identity section stable per generation; memory tail-only
non_goals: infinite identity memory or memory as credential
exporting context/memory/inbox/worktrees/secrets in a team template
risks: big migration; mitigated by additive tables and policy-off default
long-lived component branch conflicts; mitigated by session worker worktree and frequent integration
identity concurrency; one active session per identity v1
anthropomorphism; identity is accountability, not personhood
untrusted template input; validate schema/tool/model/budget/path and require approval
open_decisions: Leader concurrency: one active session v1; portfolio later
Worker workspace: per-session worktree from project component branch; identity lease
Model change: generation + approval, preserve memory
auto-apply trusted local templates is off by default
